title: Deti thi zehra sada aye mere bekas Hussain
body:
DETI THI ZEHRA SADA – AYE MERE BEKAS HUSSAIN
ZIBHA TU PYASA HUWA – AYE MERE BEKAS HUSSAIN
Lutgaya sab ghar tera, Basgayi karbobala
Jalgaye qaime sabhi, Chhingayi sar se rida
<<DIVIDER>>
Zulm ye kaisa huwa, Aye mere bekas Hussain
Qasim-o-Akber nahi, Yawar-o-Naser nahi
Aun-o-Mohammad nahi, Bezubaa’n Asgher nahi
Margaye sab aqroba, Aye mere bekas Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Behre madad aye khuda, Ab nahi koi raha
Saqtiyaa’n har gaam hai, Haal hai gham se bura
Yaara nahi zabt ka, Aye mere bekas Hussain
Ghere hain ranj-o-mehan, Baazu mein baandhi rasan
<<DIVIDER>>
Banke tamaashai hain, Raah mein sab mard-o-zan
Aati hai sabko haya, Aye mere bekas Hussain
Jayenge ab darbadar, Zere samaa’n nange sar
Daagh bahattar(72) ke hain, phhat-ta hai qalb-o-jigar
<<DIVIDER>>
Rote hain aal-e-aba, Aye mere bekas Hussain
Zulm ka baazar hai, Abid-e-beemar hai
Shaam ke darbar mein, Marhala dushwaar hai
Sabr ho kaise bhala, Aye mere bekas Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Howegi ye daastaa’n, kaise Sohail ab bayaa’n
Sunke gham-e-karbala, Sabke hai aansoo rawaa’n
Taari hai sab par buka, Aye mere bekas Hussain
